title: Station Road, Ballyduff, Co. Waterford, P51X2V1
seoTitle: Station Road, Ballyduff, Co. Waterford, P51X2V1
description:
Pamela Nel from Leonard Wilson Keenan Estate & Letting Agents are delighted to present this truly unique property to the market at Station Road, Ballyduff, Co. Waterford, P51 X2V1.

Occupying a generous site in the picturesque village of Ballyduff, this exceptional property comprises two detached residences, a detached workshop, and extensive on-site parking, all situated on one site. Offering an outstanding combination of lifestyle, investment potential and flexibility, this is a rare opportunity for owner-occupiers, investors or those seeking multi-generational living.

The main residence, extending to approximately 100 sq. m., offers bright and spacious accommodation comprising four well-proportioned bedrooms, a family bathroom, and comfortable living areas, making it an ideal family home.

The second detached residence, extending to approximately 136 sq. m., is currently operating as a successful Airbnb and presents an excellent opportunity to generate an immediate income. The accommodation comprises three spacious bedrooms, a family bathroom, and generous living accommodation throughout. A standout feature of this home is its superb outdoor entertainment area, complete with a covered lounge and a luxurious jacuzzi, providing the perfect setting for entertaining guests or relaxing in complete privacy.

Further enhancing the appeal of this exceptional property is a detached workshop, providing excellent space for storage, hobbies, a home business, or a wide variety of practical uses.

The property also benefits from extensive on-site parking, providing ample space for numerous vehicles and ensuring convenience for both residents and Airbnb guests.

The property has a BER rating of E, reflecting its traditional character while offering purchasers the opportunity to further enhance its energy efficiency over time.

Ideally located in the heart of Ballyduff, the property enjoys the peace and charm of village life while remaining within easy reach of Fermoy, Mallow, Lismore and Tallow, with Cork City also within comfortable commuting distance. Local amenities include schools, shops, cafés, sporting facilities, and the spectacular Blackwater Valley, renowned for its scenic beauty, walking trails, fishing, and outdoor pursuits.

Properties Features:

Offering two detached homes, an established Airbnb business, a detached workshop, extensive on-site parking, and premium outdoor entertaining facilities all on one site are exceptionally rare. Whether you are searching for a substantial family home with an additional income stream, accommodation for extended family, or an outstanding investment opportunity, this remarkable property is sure to impress.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, versatility, and unique lifestyle opportunity this exceptional property has to offer.
